title: Honey and Oat Cream Pots with Poached Pear
subtitle: Chilled cream and yoghurt pots with toasted oats and soft poached pear
excerpt: These no-bake cream pots come together in minutes. The toasted oats add crunch and the honey ties everything together. Serve cold, straight from the fridge.
sourceNotes: A no-bake British-style dessert drawing on the cream-and-oat tradition of cranachan. Poached pear is a classic French companion to cream desserts.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Assemble the pots up to 4 hours ahead. Add the oat topping just before serving so it stays crisp.

content.text: Whip the cream to soft peaks only. It should look like thick, just-pourable yoghurt. Over-whipped cream will make the pots grainy.

items.prepNote: toasted in a dry pan until golden

content.text: Put the pear quarters in the saucepan with enough water to just cover. Add 1 tablespoon of honey. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 10 to 12 minutes until tender when pierced with a knife.
Lift the pears out and set aside to cool. Increase the heat and boil the poaching liquid for 3 to 4 minutes until it reduces to a light syrup. Set aside.
Whip the double cream to soft peaks. Fold in the Greek yoghurt and the remaining 3 tablespoons of honey. Taste and adjust the sweetness.
Toast the oats in a dry frying pan over medium heat, stirring often, for 3 to 4 minutes until golden. Set aside to cool.
Spoon the cream mixture into four glasses or ramekins. Place the pear pieces on top. Drizzle with the reduced syrup. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Scatter the toasted oats over the top just before serving.

items.symptom: The cream mixture is runny and won't hold its shape.
items.cause: The cream was not whipped enough before folding in the yoghurt.
items.fix: Chill the pots for longer; the mixture firms up in the fridge.

items.cause: They were added before the chilling time.
items.fix: Always add oats right before serving to keep the crunch.

items.symptom: The pears are grainy and hard.
items.fix: Return to simmering water for another 5 minutes and test again.
